final: SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS circuit_avg_round, AVG(r.round) - (SELECT AVG(r2.round) FROM races AS r2 JOIN circuits AS c2 ON c2.circuitId = r2.circuitId WHERE c2.country = c.country) AS difference_from_country FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country ORDER BY difference_from_country DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
